about_the_game:
The Remainer's autopilot module has failed and the last home for humanity now faces the threat of colliding with nearby astral bodies. To prevent this, you must traverse the ship and avoid or endure the horrors of the Oblation.

EXPLORE THE REMAINER

Seperated into countless sectors, the Remainer is a dense maze filled with many secrets and terrors. Careful where you step.

COLLECT ITEMS

Mementos of the past are spread everywhere across the ship. Documents, notes, tools, medication; scavenge the belongings of your predecessors and use them to survive.

SURVIVE

There is no health bar. Inspect your arm carefully and use different cues to assess your physical and mental health. Death can creep up on you in insidious ways, never let your guard down.

UNCOVER THE REMAINER'S AGONY

The Remainer is filled with secrets that were never meant to be dug up. Uncover its rich history and discover the intricacies behind the end of the human species.

ADAPT

The shadows of humanity's darkest facets still haunt the halls of the ship, each with their own abilities granted by the Oblation. Learn how to survive them to progress through each sector.

LEVEL UP

Acquire experience by surviving and progressing through the Remainer. Gain levels and unlock perks and bonuses to help you on your journey.

This game contains extensive flashing lights and certain lore/story elements may be disturbing or upsetting to some.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains extensive flashing lights as well as potentially shocking imagery and subtext

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11 Pro 24H2
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-8600 CPU @ 3.10GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: NVIDIA High Definition Audio

short_description: The Remainer is a survival horror game in which you must travel through a colossal abandoned spaceship. Traverse and adapt to this hostile environment, gather mementos of the past, survive the horrors of this universe and keep yourself together as you plunge deeper and deeper into the unknown.
